purpose: OSCC case study (GSE208253, 12 Visium sections) run end to end through ChatSpatial MCP tools: QC and preprocessing, Leiden spatial domains, TC/LE assignment, FlashDeconv deconvolution with the Puram et al. HNSCC reference, TC vs LE marker genes, Moran's I, CellChat

inputs.visium_source: GEO GSE208253 GSM6339631-GSM6339642: filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, tissue_positions_list.csv, scalefactors_json.json, tissue_hires_image.png
inputs.reference_source: GEO GSE103322_HNSCC_all_data.txt.gz, values as deposited (log2(TPM/10+1)), labels from row 'non-cancer cell type' (0 -> Cancer)

moran.genes: all genes of the section after QC

server_info.name: ChatSpatial
server_info.title: ChatSpatial
server_info.description: Schema-enforced spatial transcriptomics analysis with 20 tools covering 66 methods across 15 analytical categories.

rule: Per Leiden domain: TC score = mean log-normalized expression of KRT14, KRT5, MKI67, PCNA, TOP2A; LE score = mean of VIM, FN1, COL1A1, COL1A2, SPARC, TGFBI (markers absent from the section are skipped). Top 2 domains by TC score -> TC; top 2 by LE score, excluding TC domains -> LE; remaining spots -> Other. Same rule as the case study (03_run_analysis.py step 4).
